top_targets.organization: League of Women Voters of Ashtabula County
top_targets.fit_rationale: Primary civic engagement organization in Ashtabula County. Actively works with the Board of Elections to increase transparency and make meeting minutes publicly available. Their mission directly aligns with civic-insight's government transparency goals.

contacts.title: President
contacts.notes: Primary decision maker for organizational partnerships

contacts.name: Cynthia Nagy
contacts.title: Voter Service Chair
contacts.notes: Directly involved in voter education and civic engagement initiatives

contacts.name: Jessica Leveto
contacts.title: Website & Social Media Admin
contacts.notes: Manages digital presence and technology decisions

top_targets.organization: Civic Development Corporation of Ashtabula County
top_targets.fit_rationale: Established in 1959, CDC improves community quality of life through stakeholder surveys, strategic objectives, and impactful projects. They partner with organizations across the county and have a $1.5M annual fundraising campaign. A civic engagement platform would help them better survey stakeholders and track community sentiment.

contacts.name: Amanda Tirotta
contacts.title: Executive Director
contacts.notes: Executive Director since 2016. Primary decision maker. Handles administrative oversight, grantee/donor relations, and campaign execution. Contact via general email or phone.

contacts.name: Lori Herpen DeCato
contacts.title: President, Board of Directors
contacts.notes: Board President since 1998. Podiatrist with strong community ties. Board leadership for strategic decisions.

contacts.name: Tim Leehan
contacts.title: Vice President, Board of Directors
contacts.notes: Vice President since 2024. Manager at Venture Land Title Agency. Active in community boards.

contacts.name: Cheryl Hellmer
contacts.title: Secretary, Board of Directors
contacts.notes: Secretary since 2017. Accounts Payable Specialist at Grand River Rubber. Manages organizational records.

contacts.name: Diana Spencer
contacts.title: Treasurer, Board of Directors
contacts.notes: Treasurer since 2021. CPA with nonprofit accounting expertise. Former Kent State accounting instructor.

top_targets.email_note: CDC uses a centralized email system (info@civicdevelopmentcorp.org). All contacts route through this address. Phone contact (440-992-2336) may be more effective for reaching specific personnel.

research_summary.mvp_description: Government transparency and civic engagement tool for Ashtabula County
research_methods: News article search for contact mentions

first_contact.angle: Reference their existing work with Board of Elections on meeting transparency. Propose collaboration on voter education platform.

second_contact.angle: Highlight stakeholder survey capabilities and community engagement tracking for their $1.5M campaign projects.

third_contact.target: LWV Ashtabula County - Cynthia Nagy (Voter Service Chair)
third_contact.angle: Focus on voter education tools and candidate forum support features.
